schema.description: Request body for updating a Company. Only the fields passed change.

joinCode.description: A unique 6-character code that can be used to join or reference this Company. Another Company with the same code answers 409.

referenceId.description: The ID of the Company in your own system. Null removes it. Another Company with the same reference answers 409.

allOf.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
allOf.title: Metadata

metadata.description: Only the keys passed change, and the others stay. An empty value removes its key, and null removes every key. The Company keeps at most 10 keys once merged, and two keys that differ only in case are one key.

schema.title: UpdateCompanyRequest

Reference.summary: Link a company to your own company ID
